topics.description: There is a growing number of allegations of fraud in Minnesota, including the investigation into Alex Pretti's death and the Zipps chain. These allegations have led to increased scrutiny of the Trump administration's response to the situation.

The Trump administration's response to the situation in Minnesota has been met with criticism, including from some Republicans. The administration has been accused of being slow to respond and of blaming the victim in the case of Alex Pretti's death.
